name: To the Moon (Apollo 11's launch)
description: Launched at Apollo 11's liftoff time, 16 July 1969 13:32 UTC, on the azimuth that puts the parking orbit's plane through the Moon: 72.3°, close to Apollo's real 72.0°. After one parking orbit the trans-lunar injection burn sends it out; three and a half days later it brakes into orbit round the Moon.
